messages:
Rae: opened PR to refresh hello-lumen quickstart (auth + first deploy + migrate notes). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1337 — need quick docs review and link check.
Tom: taking a look. Node snippet uses REDWOOD_TOKEN in one spot, other languages use REDWOOD_API_KEY. we should standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY.
Vik: also the docker-compose example doesn't map ports. CI preview failed smoke because service wasn't reachable.
Rae: good catches — i'll update the env var and add explicit ports to compose.
Tom: small nit: sample shows client.call() — update to client.generate() for SDK v5+.
Vik: pushed compose fix and HEALTHCHECK to reduce flakiness. updated docker run example to `docker run -p 8080:8080 lumen-hello`.
ci-bot: CI: lint failed on commit 7a9f3 — code fence language mismatch and deprecated API usage.
Tom: pushed commit 7b0a1 to replace client.call -> client.generate and fix fence languages.
preview-bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-1337--docs.redwood-ai.com/quickstarts/hello-lumen — quick smoke passed.
Rae: added a short migration note at the top about env var rename and client.generate; added one-line about non-deterministic outputs (do not pin seed in examples).
Vik: ran local checks, links look good. i'll do a final link sweep post-merge for any external anchors.
Rae: plan: merge once CI stays green, tag docs patch, and update changelog. ETA ~20m.
Tom: :thumbsup: will follow up if any customers ask about env var.

---

Example snippet (Node) from PR:
```js
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'lumen-mini', prompt: 'greet the world' });
console.log(res.text);
```

Action items: Rae - merge + tag release; Tom - monitor support; Vik - external redirect PR if old anchors 404.
